blocks.en: Can you hear a plant scream?
blocks.text: Can you hear a plant scream?
blocks.zh: 你聽得見植物的尖叫嗎？

blocks.en: Not metaphorically. A stressed plant emits real sound: short ultrasonic pops made by its own internal plumbing tearing itself apart. Here's the mechanism, how it was proven, and what it actually sounds like.
blocks.text: Not metaphorically. A stressed plant emits real sound: short ultrasonic pops made by its own internal plumbing tearing itself apart. Here's the mechanism, how it was proven, and what it actually sounds like.
blocks.zh: 不是比喻。受逆境的植株真的會發出聲音：那是它體內的輸水管路自行撕裂時所發出的短促超音波爆裂聲。以下是它的機制、它是怎麼被證實的，以及它實際聽起來的樣子。

blocks.en: click per hour from a healthy, watered plant
blocks.text: click per hour from a healthy, watered plant
blocks.zh: 健康且有澆水的植株每小時的喀嚓聲

blocks.text: clicks per hour once that tomato goes thirsty
blocks.zh: 番茄一旦缺水，每小時的喀嚓聲
20 至 150 kHz

blocks.en: pitch of those clicks; human hearing stops near 20 kHz
blocks.text: pitch of those clicks; human hearing stops near 20 kHz
blocks.zh: 這些喀嚓聲的音高；人類聽覺在 20 kHz 附近就停住
機制
缺水的植株為什麼會發出爆裂聲

blocks.en: Water climbs a stem under tension, pulled upward by evaporation at the leaves, the same physics that lets you draw water up a straw. Drought pushes that tension past a breaking point: air is sucked into a water-carrying channel and the column snaps from liquid into a gas-filled void. That rupture, called cavitation, releases a burst of sound. Cutting a stem causes the same failure faster, by exposing the tensioned water straight to open air.
blocks.text: Water climbs a stem under tension, pulled upward by evaporation at the leaves, the same physics that lets you draw water up a straw. Drought pushes that tension past a breaking point: air is sucked into a water-carrying channel and the column snaps from liquid into a gas-filled void. That rupture, called cavitation, releases a burst of sound. Cutting a stem causes the same failure faster, by exposing the tensioned water straight to open air.
blocks.zh: 水在莖中承受張力往上爬，被葉片的蒸發向上拉，這和你用吸管把水吸上來是同一套物理。乾旱把這股張力推過斷裂點：空氣被吸進輸水的管道，水柱從液體斷成充滿氣體的空隙。這種破裂稱為空穴化（cavitation），會釋放出一陣聲響。把莖切斷會讓同樣的破壞更快發生，因為受張力的水被直接暴露在空氣中。
證據
研究者如何錄下這些聲音

blocks.en: Ultrasonic microphones. The pops sit far above human hearing, so Khait, Hadany et al. (Tel Aviv University) recorded across 20 to 250 kHz, about 10 cm from each plant.
blocks.text: Ultrasonic microphones. The pops sit far above human hearing, so Khait, Hadany et al. (Tel Aviv University) recorded across 20 to 250 kHz, about 10 cm from each plant.
blocks.zh: 超音波麥克風。這些爆裂聲遠高於人類聽覺範圍，因此 Khait、Hadany 等人（特拉維夫大學）在距離每株植物約 10 cm 處，以 20 至 250 kHz 的範圍錄音。

blocks.en: A soundproofed chamber first. Tomato and tobacco recorded three ways: untouched, five days without water, and freshly cut.
blocks.text: A soundproofed chamber first. Tomato and tobacco recorded three ways: untouched, five days without water, and freshly cut.
blocks.zh: 先在隔音室裡。番茄與菸草各以三種方式錄音：未受擾動、五天不給水，以及剛被切斷。

blocks.en: Then a working greenhouse. Repeated amid ordinary background noise to prove it wasn't a laboratory artifact.
blocks.text: Then a working greenhouse. Repeated amid ordinary background noise to prove it wasn't a laboratory artifact.
blocks.zh: 再到實際運作的溫室。在一般的背景噪音中重做一次，以證明這不是實驗室裡的假象。

blocks.en: Machine learning. A classifier trained on many acoustic features (not one number) separated stressed from healthy, drought from cutting, and tomato from tobacco.
blocks.text: Machine learning. A classifier trained on many acoustic features (not one number) separated stressed from healthy, drought from cutting, and tomato from tobacco.
blocks.zh: 機器學習。以多項聲學特徵（而不是單一數值）訓練的分類器，分出了受逆境與健康、乾旱與切斷，以及番茄與菸草。
聆聽
這些錄音

blocks.en: Pitch-shifted down into audible range, with irregular gaps so each pop stands alone. Every dot on a graph is one real click: height is its pitch, size is how loud it was, and it appears as you hear it.
blocks.text: Pitch-shifted down into audible range, with irregular gaps so each pop stands alone. Every dot on a graph is one real click: height is its pitch, size is how loud it was, and it appears as you hear it.
blocks.zh: 音高已往下移到可聽見的範圍，並以不規則的間隔播放，讓每個爆裂聲各自獨立。圖上每一個點都是一個真實的喀嚓聲：高度是它的音高，大小是它的響度，而它會在你聽見的同時出現。

blocks.en: The seconds on each graph are just how far you are into this short recording, not how long the plant was stressed. Drought played out over five days and a cut stem ruptures within moments; either way, what you're hearing is only a short excerpt of that.
blocks.text: The seconds on each graph are just how far you are into this short recording, not how long the plant was stressed. Drought played out over five days and a cut stem ruptures within moments; either way, what you're hearing is only a short excerpt of that.
blocks.zh: 每張圖上的秒數只是你聽到這段短錄音的哪個位置，不是植株受逆境的時間長度。乾旱是在五天之間發展的，被切斷的莖則在瞬間就破裂；無論哪一種，你聽到的都只是其中一小段摘錄。

blocks.en: Can you tell the stresses apart?
blocks.text: Can you tell the stresses apart?
blocks.zh: 你分辨得出不同的逆境嗎？

blocks.en: Peak frequency of ~2500 clicks measured straight from the original recordings, grouped into five conditions. Look at the two shaded zones below: a healthy plant's clicks stay low and separate (gray), while every stressed plant (drought or cut, tomato or tobacco) clicks noticeably higher (orange). Telling those two zones apart is easy. Telling the four stressed conditions apart from each other is the hard part.
blocks.text: Peak frequency of ~2500 clicks measured straight from the original recordings, grouped into five conditions. Look at the two shaded zones below: a healthy plant's clicks stay low and separate (gray), while every stressed plant (drought or cut, tomato or tobacco) clicks noticeably higher (orange). Telling those two zones apart is easy. Telling the four stressed conditions apart from each other is the hard part.
blocks.zh: 直接從原始錄音測得的約 2500 個喀嚓聲的峰值頻率，依五種條件分組。看下方兩塊有底色的區域：健康植株的喀嚓聲維持在低處，而且自成一區（灰色）；而每一種受逆境的植株（乾旱或切斷、番茄或菸草），喀嚓聲的音高都明顯更高（橘色）。要把這兩區分開很容易，難的是把四種受逆境條件彼此分開。

blocks.en: Shape = how that condition's clicks are spread across pitch. A taller point means more clicks landed near that pitch.
blocks.text: Shape = how that condition's clicks are spread across pitch. A taller point means more clicks landed near that pitch.
blocks.zh: 形狀＝該條件的喀嚓聲在音高上的分布。某處的點越高，表示有越多喀嚓聲落在那個音高附近。

blocks.en: Dot = the median: the "typical" click. Exactly half of that condition's clicks were higher-pitched than this, half were lower.
blocks.text: Dot = the median: the "typical" click. Exactly half of that condition's clicks were higher-pitched than this, half were lower.
blocks.zh: 圓點＝中位數，也就是「典型」的喀嚓聲。該條件的喀嚓聲剛好有一半音高比它高，一半比它低。

blocks.en: The gray and orange zones barely touch, but the four orange shapes sit almost on top of each other.
blocks.text: The gray and orange zones barely touch, but the four orange shapes sit almost on top of each other.
blocks.zh: 灰色與橘色區域幾乎不相接，但四個橘色形狀幾乎完全疊在一起。

blocks.en:
Scored for separability, background noise splits from plant clicks
      cleanly (AUC 0.88), while the four stress conditions score just 0.53 to 0.65 against each other, barely
      above the 0.50 of a coin flip. That is exactly why the study needed a machine-learning model trained on many
      features at once, not a threshold on one number. What gives a stressed plant away isn't the sound of any single
      pop. It's how often they come.
blocks.text: Scored for separability, background noise splits from plant clicks cleanly (AUC 0.88), while the four stress conditions score just 0.53 to 0.65 against each other, barely above the 0.50 of a coin flip. That is exactly why the study needed a machine-learning model trained on many features at once, not a threshold on one number. What gives a stressed plant away isn't the sound of any single pop. It's how often they come.
blocks.zh: 以可分性來評分，背景噪音與植物喀嚓聲能乾淨地分開（AUC 0.88），而四種逆境條件彼此之間只得到 0.53 至 0.65，僅略高於擲硬幣的 0.50。這正是為什麼該研究需要一個同時以多項特徵訓練的機器學習模型，而不是在單一數值上設一個閾值。真正洩漏植株受逆境的，不是任何單一爆裂聲的聲音，而是它們出現得有多頻繁。

blocks.en: Every frequency shown is the peak frequency of a single click, computed by FFT directly from the original 500 kHz recordings (275 to 600 clicks per condition in the comparison chart). As a check, 98% of measured clicks fall inside the 20 to 100 kHz range the paper reports, and 71% inside the 40 to 80 kHz band its authors described, but the per-click values are our own measurements, not figures published in the paper. Pitch-shifting, click spacing and the hour simulation were produced for this page: true gaps between clicks run to minutes, so spacing here is compressed while keeping its irregular character.
blocks.text: Every frequency shown is the peak frequency of a single click, computed by FFT directly from the original 500 kHz recordings (275 to 600 clicks per condition in the comparison chart). As a check, 98% of measured clicks fall inside the 20 to 100 kHz range the paper reports, and 71% inside the 40 to 80 kHz band its authors described, but the per-click values are our own measurements, not figures published in the paper. Pitch-shifting, click spacing and the hour simulation were produced for this page: true gaps between clicks run to minutes, so spacing here is compressed while keeping its irregular character.
blocks.zh: 圖中顯示的每一個頻率都是單一喀嚓聲的峰值頻率，直接以 FFT 從原始的 500 kHz 錄音計算而得（比較圖中每種條件 275 至 600 個喀嚓聲）。作為核對，所測得的喀嚓聲有 98% 落在論文所報告的 20 至 100 kHz 範圍內，71% 落在作者描述的 40 至 80 kHz 帶內；但逐一喀嚓聲的數值是我們自己的測量結果，不是論文中發表的數據。音高下移、喀嚓聲的間隔與那一小時的模擬都是為本頁製作的：喀嚓聲之間真實的間隔可長達數分鐘，因此這裡的間隔經過壓縮，但保留了它不規則的特性。
